answer: Social Matters >> Food & Drinks Question ID: 6621 Country: India Title: Can I drink Red Bull that is energy drink? Question: Can I drink Red Bull that is energy drink? Answer ID: 6621 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 642/642=M-1429 We do not know the ingredients of Red Bull. You should first do investigation. There is no wrong to drink if it does not contain any impure agent and it is not intoxicant. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
